overview: Local artist and advocate Louise Musto-Choate appeared on 'Meeting Interesting People' to discuss her creative career. She described her acrylic pour painting techniques, her jewelry making, and ongoing community efforts to establish arts spaces in Medford.

items.title: Medford Arts Advocacy and Arts Collaborative Medford
items.summary: Louise Musto-Choate discussed local cultural initiatives, including CACHE and community efforts with Arts Collaborative Medford to secure a permanent home for the arts in the city.

items.title: Acrylic Pour Painting and Exhibition
items.summary: Musto-Choate explained how she took up acrylic fluid painting through online tutorials, demonstrating various pouring and swiping techniques that earned her a ribbon at the Danvers Art Association.

items.title: Functional Art, Substrates, and Resin
items.summary: Musto-Choate described applying her abstract designs to functional items like resin-coated tiles and decorative boxes, as well as experimenting with cradled wood panels and mica powders.

items.title: Creative Background and Jewelry Making
items.summary: Musto-Choate recounted turning to new crafts following health challenges, tracing her progression from beadwork and precious metal clay jewelry to upcoming exhibits at the Medford Public Library and local venues.
